summary: Make target analysis fail closed at filesystem boundaries and expose deterministic evidence, calibration limits, approved harnesses, and portable invocations.

migration.note: Analyzer automation that wants non-default harnesses must pass its organization-approved allowlist through -ApprovedHarnesses and consume target-analysis schema version 2.

compatibility.note: The analyzer no longer treats profile defaults or detected target instruction files as harness authorization; JSON output adds a versioned evidence and invocation contract.
